description: Skilled-migration application assistance commonly runs USD 1,500-6,000; litigation such as mandamus USD 3,000-12,000; complex or appeal work more.
Diaspora communities are heavily targeted by unlicensed agents. Money is lost and, worse, a badly prepared application creates a refusal that follows the applicant permanently.
Applicants prefer Persian-speaking advisers, which shrinks the market and raises the chance of ending up with whoever is available rather than whoever is good.
